title: Data-driven structural analysis of small cell lung cancer transcription factor network suggests potential subtype regulators and transition pathways.
one_liner_zh: 该文用图论分析小细胞肺癌转录因子网络结构，识别亚型调控枢纽并模拟亚型转变，虽涉及TF网络但无蛋白-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅网络结构分析，与课题关联有限。
abstract: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive disease and challenging to treat due to its mixture of transcriptional subtypes and subtype transitions. Transcription factor (TF) networks have been the focus of studies to identify SCLC subtype regulators via systems approaches. Yet, their structures, which can provide clues on subtype drivers and transitions, are barely investigated. Here, we analyze the structure of an SCLC TF network by using graph theory concepts and identify its structurally important components responsible for complex signal processing, called hubs. We show that the hubs of the network are regulators of different SCLC subtypes by analyzing first the unbiased network structure and then integrating RNA-seq data as weights assigned to each interaction. Data-driven analysis emphasizes MYC as a hub, consistent with recent reports. Furthermore, we hypothesize that the pathways connecting functionally distinct hubs may control subtype transitions and test this hypothesis via network simulations on a candidate pathway and observe subtype transition. Overall, structural analyses of complex networks can identify their functionally important components and pathways driving the network dynamics. Such analyses can be an initial step for generating hypotheses and can guide the discovery of target pathways whose perturbation may change the network dynamics phenotypically.
abstract_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种侵袭性疾病，因其转录亚型混合及亚型转换而难以治疗。转录因子（TF）网络一直是研究重点，旨在通过系统方法识别SCLC亚型调控因子。然而，这些网络的结构，虽能提供关于亚型驱动因素和转换的线索，却鲜少被探究。在此，我们利用图论概念分析SCLC TF网络的结构，并识别其负责复杂信号处理的结构重要组件，称为枢纽（hubs）。我们通过首先分析无偏网络结构，然后整合RNA-seq数据作为每条相互作用的权重，展示网络枢纽是不同SCLC亚型的调控因子。数据驱动分析强调MYC为枢纽，与近期报道一致。此外，我们假设连接功能不同枢纽的通路可能控制亚型转换，并通过候选通路的网络模拟测试此假设，观察到亚型转换。总体而言，复杂网络的结构分析能识别其功能重要组件及驱动网络动态的通路。此类分析可作为生成假设的初步步骤，并指导发现靶向通路，其扰动可能在表型上改变网络动态。
